main.description: A Ratioed data visualisation, placed inside a pub.leaflet.content page alongside the standard pub.leaflet.blocks.* types. Renderers that don't know this type skip it, so any block of this type should be followed by a plain text block carrying the same figures in prose.

variant.description: summary — the project in six figures. lifelines — every backlink plotted against time, with the threadgate as a hard rule and a log-scaled afterlife. reaction — how long the artist took to close each piece by hand. ledger — engagement before and after the seal, per piece. hidden — the replies that landed after a seal, written to the network but hidden by the threadgate. participants — everyone who touched a piece. when — every piece placed on a week grid by day and time of day, in the artist’s local zone, each mark sized by how long the piece lived and how much it drew.

alt.description: Plain-language description of what the chart shows, for screen readers. Not rendered on the page — the caption is the visible prose.

showLive.description: Query Constellation on render and show how much engagement each piece has accrued since it was measured. Only the lifelines and ledger variants read this. The recorded figures stay authoritative; this only adds a delta.

caption.description: Prose shown under the chart. Absent means the chart's own built-in description is used, which quotes the live figures and so stays correct as the data changes; anything set here is fixed text.

showCaption.description: Whether to render the caption at all. Absent counts as true.
